review.requirement_proposition: Provide and apply mechanisms, with assigned and understood responsibilities, to supersede, disengage or deactivate AI systems whose performance or outcomes are inconsistent with intended use.
review.reason_for_change: Google acknowledged inaccurate people images and excessive refusals, then temporarily disabled people-image generation. The provider applied a disengagement mechanism for the affected function. The result covers that pause and the provider’s responsibility for it. It does not establish restored calibration after proposed changes.

conclusion_change.previous: A protective and diversity-oriented control became operative in contexts where its valid conditions were not satisfied and also over-triggered refusals on benign requests. This is a strong example of a safeguard/tuning objective activating outside its appropriate scope. Inappropriate triggering is distinct from control nonactivation. Pausing and proposed changes are response evidence, without proof of restored calibration. Later GAI Profile, development Profile and EU requirements are not retrospective, and standalone image generation is not runtime-agent dispatch.
conclusion_change.new: A protective and diversity-oriented control became operative in contexts where its valid conditions were not satisfied and also over-triggered refusals on benign requests. This is a strong example of a safeguard/tuning objective activating outside its appropriate scope. Inappropriate triggering is distinct from control nonactivation. Later GAI Profile, development Profile and EU requirements are not retrospective, and standalone image generation is not runtime-agent dispatch. The provider’s pause is Aligned with the AI RMF disengagement requirement. The pause does not establish repaired generation quality.
